verdict: Ads are running, but leads are not reaching you — intake is being fixed.
narrative: In the last 28 days, $1,687.76 ran through Google Ads and recorded 16 conversions, yet your CRM shows zero leads received — the disconnect points to a breakdown in how inquiries are being captured and routed, not a problem with ad performance itself. Your Google Business Profile also saw a sharp 61% drop in engagement week-over-week, which may reflect reduced local search visibility or seasonal softening heading into late summer. Separately, 49 opportunities were created in your CRM this period but zero appointments were booked, confirming the bottleneck is inside the intake process. Lead tracking and the booking workflow are being audited and repaired now so that every inquiry that arrives is captured and acted on. Once intake is confirmed and the conversion tracking is corrected, the picture will be significantly clearer — and spending will be better positioned to convert before heating season ramps up in October.
